meta.name: geomaster
meta.description: Comprehensive geospatial science skill covering remote sensing, GIS, spatial analysis, machine learning for earth observation, and 30+ scientific domains. Supports satellite imagery processing (Sentinel, Landsat, MODIS, SAR, hyperspectral), vector and raster data operations, spatial statistics, point cloud processing, network analysis, cloud-native workflows (STAC, COG, Planetary Computer), and 8 programming languages (Python, R, Julia, JavaScript, C++, Java, Go, Rust) with 500+ code examples. Use for remote sensing workflows, GIS analysis, spatial ML, Earth observation data processing, terrain analysis, hydrological modeling, marine spatial analysis, atmospheric science, and any geospatial computation task.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析卫星影像与地理空间数据,构建空间机器学习模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常处理卫星影像和地理空间数据,需要多语言示例
copy.tagline_en: Process satellite imagery and geospatial data, and build spatial machine learning models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with remote sensing and GIS data and need code examples in multiple languages

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 能处理地理空间计算任务：卫星影像处理、GIS 空间分析、空间统计、地形与水文建模等，可提供 Python、R、Julia 等语言的代码，并支持 STAC、COG 等云原生数据工作流。
howto.when: 当用户提出遥感影像处理、GIS 分析、空间机器学习、地形或水文建模、海洋或大气空间分析等地理空间计算任务时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 Sentinel-2 影像算 NDVI，并出结果图。
say.note: 会给出用 Rasterio 读取波段的代码。

say.text: 把这两个 GeoJSON 做空间连接，按区域统计人口。
say.note: 会用 GeoPandas 完成连接与聚合。

say.text: 用 STAC 搜某区域云量低于 20% 的影像。
say.note: 会调用 Planetary Computer 等目录。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can handle geospatial computation tasks: satellite imagery processing, GIS spatial analysis, spatial statistics, terrain and hydrological modeling, etc. It can produce code in Python, R, Julia and more, and support cloud-native workflows like STAC and COG.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for remote sensing image processing, GIS analysis, spatial ML, terrain/hydrological modeling, marine or atmospheric spatial analysis, or other geospatial computation tasks.

say_en.text: Compute NDVI from Sentinel-2 imagery and plot the result.
say_en.note: Will provide Rasterio-based code to read bands.

say_en.text: Spatially join these two GeoJSON files and aggregate population by zone.
say_en.note: Will use GeoPandas for join and aggregation.

say_en.text: Search for satellite images with cloud cover below 20% via STAC.
say_en.note: Will query catalogs like Planetary Computer.
